audience: Urbeno Super Admins — day-to-day Masters, Audit, Compliance, and lifecycle controls (pair with the Complete Lifecycle guide)

steps.title: Step 1 — Sign in as Super Admin
steps.howTo:
1. Open https://tectrack.urbeno.in.
2. Enter your Super Admin email and password.
3. Complete MFA if enrolled; accept policies on first login.
steps.tips: Protect MFA. Super Admin can backdate historical dates from 2026-04-01 across the lifecycle.

steps.title: Step 2 — Super Admin dashboard
steps.howTo:
1. Review KPIs, Acknowledge queue, and work queues.
2. Full nav: Dashboard, Requests, Heroes, Sustainability, Capacity, Masters, Reports, Audit, Compliance.
3. For a full mock walkthrough with every form filled, use the Super Admin Lifecycle Training Guide PDF.
steps.tips: You see every organisation — treat data as confidential.

steps.title: Step 3 — Requests queue
steps.howTo:
1. Open Requests and scan stages 1–9.
2. Open Stage 1 to Acknowledge; open later stages for invoice / CoD.
3. Keep unique suffixes on registration / invoice / e-way / certificate numbers in training re-runs.
steps.tips: Walk one request carefully before bulk practice.

steps.title: Step 4 — Stage 1 request detail
steps.howTo:
1. Open a Stage 1 request.
2. Read site, approx weight, notes, BoM.
3. Acknowledge, Request changes, or Reject.
steps.tips: Do not invent missing client site details.

steps.title: Step 5 — Acknowledge Request modal
steps.howTo:
1. Click Acknowledge Request.
2. Review modal summary and confirm.
steps.tips: Acknowledgement email uses the Request Acknowledgement template.

steps.title: Step 6 — Assign Vehicle (historical backdate)
steps.howTo:
1. Click Assign Vehicle.
2. Enter registration, driver, phone, expected pickup.
3. Super Admin historical expected pickup from 2026-04-01 when the hint appears.
steps.tips: Operations cannot use the historical window.

steps.title: Step 7 — Invoiced / advanced request detail
steps.howTo:
1. Open an invoiced or closed demo request.
2. Review vehicles, weighment evidence, invoices, MRN/Form 6/CoD cards.
3. Use Raise Invoice / Record Payment / Upload Certificate when those controls appear on live work.
steps.tips: See the Lifecycle Training Guide for a filled Raise Invoice / Payment / CoD walkthrough on a fresh mock REQ.

steps.title: Step 10 — Upload Certificate form
steps.howTo:
1. Click Upload Certificate after Form 6 approval.
2. Enter unique certificate number and date; attach signed PDF.
steps.tips: Never reuse certificate numbers.

steps.title: Step 11 — Form 6 / admin review area
steps.howTo:
1. Review Recycling / Form 6 on the invoice.
2. Approve & release when Factory submitted for review.
3. Download Form 6 PDF for the audit pack.
steps.tips: Do not upload CoD before Form 6 is approved.

steps.title: Step 12 — Capacity oversight
steps.howTo:
1. Open Capacity.
2. Review utilisation and support documented overrides.
steps.tips: Overrides are audited.

steps.title: Step 13 — Recycling Heroes
steps.howTo:
1. Open Recycling Heroes.
2. Review plantings and tonnage.
3. Record planting when authorised.
steps.tips: Keep photo evidence.

steps.title: Step 14 — Sustainability
steps.howTo:
1. Open Sustainability.
2. Review impact figures for client packs.
steps.tips: Closed work drives totals.

steps.title: Step 15 — Reports
steps.howTo:
1. Open Reports.
2. Run operational and compliance reports.
3. Export with correct tenancy filters.
steps.tips: Store multi-client exports securely.

steps.title: Step 16 — Masters
steps.howTo:
1. Open Masters.
2. Tabs: Users, Clients, Sites, Factories, Categories, Lookups, Email, Company.
3. Prefer deactivate over delete for referenced sites.
steps.tips: Letterhead feeds Form 6 and MRN PDFs.

steps.title: Step 17 — Users & roles
steps.howTo:
1. Open Users.
2. Roles include Client Read Only and Auditor.
3. Reset passwords out-of-band; resets are audited.
steps.tips: Staff/auditor emails must be @urbeno.in.

steps.title: Step 18 — Clients & sites
steps.howTo:
1. Open Clients & Sites.
2. Create/edit clients (4-letter codes).
3. Deactivate sites rather than deleting.
steps.tips: Reserved prefixes like URB / ADM / SYS / TEST are refused.

steps.title: Step 19 — Audit trail
steps.howTo:
1. Open Audit.
2. Filter by REQ-, actor, action, date.
3. Confirm lifecycle events for chain of custody.
steps.tips: Missing events block production sign-off.

steps.title: Step 20 — Compliance
steps.howTo:
1. Open Compliance.
2. Review registers and control status.
3. Confirm non-admin roles cannot open this area.
steps.tips: Factory/client reaching Compliance is a Blocker.

steps.title: Step 21 — Profile, MFA, letterhead
steps.howTo:
1. Open Profile.
2. Manage MFA and password.
3. Edit letterhead/company details if shown.
steps.tips: Letterhead mistakes appear on legal PDFs.

steps.title: Step 22 — Sign out
steps.howTo:
1. Logout.
2. Confirm Sign In.
3. Lock workstation if stepping away.
steps.tips: Treat admin sessions like production console access.
